stories.summary: Google is adding agentic capabilities to Gemini, initially for businesses, so it can plan and execute tasks across workplace applications and systems. The agent can delegate work to subagents, use multiple AI models and operate with its own workplace identity and email address.

links.headline: Google brings agentic AI to Gemini, starting with businesses
links.excerpt: Google is turning Gemini into an AI agent that can plan, execute tasks, and work across business apps and systems. The agent can delegate work to subagents, use multiple AI models, and even gets its own workplace identity, complete with an email address.

stories.title: EU drops sponsorship of disinformation conference at Trump officials’ request
stories.summary: The EU’s diplomatic service, Canada and Lithuania withdrew sponsorship from the #Disinfo2026 conference after pressure from the Trump administration, according to The Guardian. Their logos were removed from the event website days before the European conference was due to take place.

stories.title: Cocaine-Funded Gangs Shake Colombia Years After Peace Pact
stories.summary: Cocaine-funded militias are attacking civilians in Colombia eight years after a peace accord removed a major rebel group from the field. The Wall Street Journal attributes the continuing violence to state inaction following the agreement.

stories.title: Canada Is Becoming a Fentanyl Exporter, and a Target for Trump
stories.summary: Fentanyl is increasingly being manufactured in and trafficked from Canada, drawing scrutiny from the Trump administration. The Wall Street Journal says the volumes remain small compared with those associated with Mexico.

links.headline: Canada Is Becoming a Fentanyl Exporter, and a Target for Trump
links.excerpt: The drug is increasingly manufactured in and trafficked from the U.S.’s northern neighbor, though the numbers remain small compared with Mexico.
